tool.name: NetProbe
tool.description: Comprehensive network test tool: ping, traceroute, port scan, TLS, DNS and a findings list per target.
tool.long_description: Enter an IP address, DNS name, network (CIDR) or range. Single addresses go straight into the list, networks are scanned. For every target NetProbe runs a battery of tests you can switch on and off by category: ping with latency, jitter and TTL, parallel traceroute with per-hop analysis, TCP port scan with a library of 130+ services and typical usage scenarios, HTTP and TLS inspection, SMB/RDP/NTP checks and full DNS diagnostics for names. Each target opens its own dockable tab with results per category plus a Findings tab. No admin rights required.
